requirements.title: Automatic Replies to Comments
requirements.definition: Automatically respond to comments received through the configured social media accounts where supported.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers general comment-response behavior; recognizing configured keywords and delivering keyword-specific resources are independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Automatic Responses to Likes
requirements.definition: Automatically respond to social-media likes where the connected platform and GHL support that trigger.
requirements.boundary_note: Like-triggered behavior is separate from comment and direct-message behavior because platform support and execution can differ independently.

requirements.title: Automatic Replies to Direct Messages
requirements.definition: Automatically reply to incoming direct messages on supported connected social platforms.
requirements.boundary_note: Established by the client-authored job description; direct-message handling can be configured, supported, or fail independently from comment and like responses.

requirements.title: Keyword Trigger Detection
requirements.definition: Recognize configured engagement keywords and activate the corresponding GHL automation.
requirements.boundary_note: The individual keywords are attributes of one trigger-detection mechanism; delivery and display of the mapped response resource remain independently testable.

requirements.title: Keyword Response Resource Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver the appropriate complete response, follow-up, PDF, or linked resource after a configured keyword activates an automation.
requirements.boundary_note: Resource mappings are attributes of this delivery mechanism. It is separate from keyword recognition because a trigger can activate successfully while its PDF or response content is incomplete.

requirements.title: Social Engagement Lead Capture
requirements.definition: Capture leads generated through the configured social-media engagement automations in GHL.
requirements.boundary_note: Established by the client-authored job description; creating the lead record is separate from enrolling that record in the correct downstream workflow.

requirements.title: Lead Workflow Enrollment
requirements.definition: Enroll each captured lead in the appropriate GHL workflow for the relevant business context.
requirements.boundary_note: Workflow routing is independently testable from lead capture because a lead may be stored successfully but assigned to the wrong workflow.

source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]
I need assistance repairing and improving your social media automation funnel.
There are 2 FB, 2 IG, and 1 TK accounts. I want GHL to function like ManyChat.
Scope of Work:
* Examine your current funnel and automation configuration.
* Find and resolve any problems stopping the automation from operating correctly.
* Configure automated responses to comments and likes.
* Create keyword-triggered replies (if applicable).
* Test the full workflow from beginning to end to confirm it works properly.
*Implement any required changes.
